**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
Is there any way that El Maven could (or can currently?) select the peaks for the bookmarks that I have already made and apply them to new samples that I add into the program later on? For example, my files are very large, so it is easier to select/bookmark peaks with just one replicate of each of my samples, and then if I could add the other replicates in once I have bookmarked my peaks and have it apply to those? Currently, if I add new samples in later, it just spits out 'NA' for those peaks.

Above
